Your mission
• Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems
• Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product
• Definition of the digital system architecture in close crossfunctional cooperation with other departments
• Design and implementation of digital signal processing chains and control loops
• Bring-up, verification and debugging of FPGA designs on target hardware, including measurements and performance analysis
• Creation of verification plans, testbenches and test procedures, as well as development of prototypes and support of system-level verification and validation campaigns
• Documentation of the design according to customer and quality requirements

Your profile
• Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a comparable qualification
• 2+ years of experience in FPGA/digital design with Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL
• Practical experience with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or comparable toolchains, including synthesis, place-and-route and static timing analysis
• Experience with SoC platforms and the interplay between Processing System (PS) and Programmable Logic (PL)
• Solid understanding of digital signal processing fundamentals and experience implementing digital control loops
• Experience with Python/NumPy or MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm exploration, fixed-point modelling and verification against RTL
• Enjoyment of hands-on lab work combined with a high level of initiative and sense of responsibility
• Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus

Why us?
• Exciting and challenging tasks in a dynamically growing market
• Independent work in a highly motivated team with creative freedom
• Remuneration that gives you a share in the company's success and a company pension scheme
• Individual and practice-oriented training and opportunities for professional development
• JobRad-Leasing or free Deutschlandticket
• 30 days' vacation and regular employee events
• A secure job and a permanent position
• Flat hierarchies, an informal culture and short decision-making paths

About usMenlo Systems is a high-tech company that develops, manufactures and sells lasers and laser systems for precision applications in research and industry. Menlo Systems is one of the market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology. The company is headquartered in Martinsried, near Munich, Germany.

ABOUT THE ROLEERC System develops uncrewed aircraft for certified operation, in a regulatory landscape that is still being written. This role is our presence in the standardisation bodies and industry associations where that landscape takes shape — EUROCAE, GAMA, UAVDACH and BDLI among them — in the working groups drafting the certification specifications, AMC, MOC and supporting standards our aircraft will be measured against. You bring our position into those rooms while the text is still open, and you bring back what it means for us. Inside the company you turn the evolving framework into the certification basis our programmes build against, take part in the exchange with the certification authorities, and support the airworthiness team on compliance work.
WHAT YOU WILL DO● Represent ERC in the associations and standardisation bodies shaping UAS certification standards ● Work inside the drafting groups: comment on drafts, defend positions and follow them through the process ● Track rulemaking and standardisation, and assess early what they mean for our approval route ● Build ERC positions on draft material with engineering, and turn them into written contributions ● Derive and maintain the certification basis for our programmes ● Take part in the exchange with the certification authorities and prepare the input that goes with it ● Support airworthiness on means of compliance and evidence, and flag external changes early

WHAT YOU BRING● Deep, hands-on experience in aviation certification, gained in aircraft or UAS programmes ● Command of the European UAS regulatory system and the derivation of a certification basis ● Experience working in industry associations, standardisation bodies or rulemaking groups ● Comfort in committee settings, where influence comes from preparation rather than authority ● Enough engineering depth to support means of compliance, not only the regulatory argument ● A technical degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable field ● Fluent English, and German at working proficiency for committee and authority work Moreover, it would be helpful if you also ● have worked in an SC Light-UAS or Design Verification Report context ● bring EASA Compliance Verification Engineer experience ● know the military side too, such as STANAG 4671 ● bring an existing network in the European UAS standardisation and association landscape ● bring experience with ARP4754B and ARP4761A

WHAT WEC OFFER● Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides ● A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn ● Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution ● Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation ● Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen ● Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

DIRECTOR, REGULATORY AFFAIRS (F/M/D)

In this role, you'll contribute to the design, development, testing, and continuous improvement of software products while working closely with cross-functional teams in an agile environment. Your work will directly impact the quality, reliability, and performance of technologies used across global clinical trials.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Lead global regulatory activities to ensure compliance with FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, and international medical and non-medical device regulations

*
Define and implement regulatory strategies across the full product lifecycle, from development to post-market

*
Partner with Product Management, Logistics, and Engineering teams to ensure compliant product development and global market access

*
Establish and optimize global processes for trade compliance, import/export, and supply chain regulatory requirements

*
Guide and mentor a team of hardware and software development engineers, providing regulatory expertise across projects such as respiratory, imaging, and cardiac safety solutions

*
Assess regulatory impact of changes to design, materials, labeling, software, and suppliers

*
Support regulatory submissions, including FDA 510(k) filings and international product registrations

*
Review and approve product labeling, technical documentation, and marketing materials to ensure regulatory alignment

*
Participate in internal, external, and vendor audits and contribute to corrective and preventive action initiatives

*
Act as Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) under MDR requirements

*
Oversee the development and maintenance of SOPs and work instructions aligned with global standards

*
Support post-market surveillance, vigilance reporting, and continuous improvement activities

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical field

*
6+ years of experience in the medical device industry

*
4+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within medical devices or pharmaceutical products

*
3+ years of proven leadership experience managing or guiding teams

*
Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, ISO standards, and global medical device requirements (including 510(k) submissions and MDR)

*
Experience interacting with regulatory authorities and supporting audits and inspections

*
Understanding of clinical trial environments and GCP is highly desirable

*
Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills

*
Fluency in English and German

*
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to manage complex regulatory challenges

It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Your job in the future market of lasers and photonics

Since its foundation, Menlo Systems GmbH has been one of the world market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers. Based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology, we provide our customers worldwide with laser systems that enable applications with the highest precision and accuracy. The systems are mainly used in metrology and spectroscopy, in optical clocks, in quantum technology and quantum computers, as well as in materials testing and 3D printing. Our customers include leading research institutions and high-tech companies worldwide.

To strengthen our team at our main location in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, we are now looking for a

FPGA / Mixed-Signal Design Engineer (m/f/d)

Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems

Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product

Definition of the digital system architecture in close crossfunctional cooperation with other departments
Design and implementation of digital signal processing chains and control loops

Bring-up, verification and debugging of FPGA designs on target hardware, including measurements and performance analysis

Creation of verification plans, testbenches and test procedures, as well as development of prototypes and support of system-level verification and validation campaigns

Documentation of the design according to customer and quality requirements

Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a comparable qualification

2+ years of experience in FPGA/digital design with Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL

Practical experience with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or comparable toolchains, including synthesis, place-and-route and static timing analysis

Experience with SoC platforms and the interplay between Processing System (PS) and Programmable Logic (PL)
Solid understanding of digital signal processing fundamentals and experience implementing digital control loops

Experience with Python/NumPy or MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm exploration, fixed-point modelling and verification against RTL

Enjoyment of hands-on lab work combined with a high level of initiative and sense of responsibility
Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus

About us

Job description

In order to support the digital architecture team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know work of a digital architect focusing on the frontier of AI? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the digital architecture team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn in the Munich area
- Start: November 2026
- Duration: 12 -24 months

The mission of the architecture unit is to plan and design state of the art, sustainable and secured enterprise digital solutions for our customers, partners and everybody and you can be part of this exciting journey. The transformation programs architecture team, which you will become part of, has the particular mission to define the future to-be target architecture for a full digital continuity of all key value streams of the company. This includes the design of the major enterprise platforms like ALM, PLM, ERP, CRM, MOM/MES but also technology watch and application of emerging technologies. You will specifically focus on the intersection of AI and Data: exploring Agentic Coding, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and building a unified Semantic Layer (using Neo4j) to enable seamless data integration between architect management tools like Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Travelling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contribute to the research and exploration of Agentic AI workflows and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise use cases.
- Contribute to the development of a Semantic Layer using Graph Databases (Neo4j) to integrate data across Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.
- Contribute to the design of automated data pipelines and semantic mappings between disparate enterprise architecture tools.
- Contribute to the deployment and orchestration of AI-driven services and integration layers within OpenShift environments.
- Contribute to the modeling of the digital architecture on different layers (business, functional, data, technical) to support the semantic integration.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of computer science, data science, engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in Python programming or working with Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j) is highly desirable.
- Interest in cutting-edge AI developments, specifically LLM Agents, RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native environments like OpenShift is a plus.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and data integration patterns is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord.
